gradingPolicy: TODO: frozen objective tests or blinded rubric, grader version and evaluation cost

costAccounting.sourcePolicy: Official provider pricing and billing/usage documentation for each exact model, version and endpoint.
costAccounting.aggregation: Sum documented non-overlapping billing meters from actual usage for every attempt, plus applicable non-token fees and declared deployment overhead.
costAccounting.missingUsagePolicy: Unknown, never zero or fabricated from visible output; invoice is optional, actual usage and applicable official rates are required.
costAccounting.claimScope: Official-price-accounted costs; not account discounts, subscriptions or intermediary invoices. Standard API equivalent costs on other channels must be labeled separately.

split.method: SHA256('dsh-selftest-v1:' + groupId), first 8 hex digits as integer modulo 100

baselineSelectionPolicy: Validation mean quality descending, mean cost ascending, stable action ID ascending. Missing validation domain falls back to global validation-best-single; no complete global validation cohort means stop, never use test labels.
sampleSizeRationale: TODO: planning after pilot; no automatic power guarantee
missingDataPolicy: Unknown quality/cost is not zero; no outcome-conditioned exclusions; report full coverage and missingness.
